_note: Demo credentials are prefilled on the sign-in screen so the app can be tried without typing. Replace this file and the AuthRepository when wiring a real backend.

onboarding.title:
Every card,
one balance
onboarding.body: Strata gathers your cards into a single wallet and keeps the running total honest, down to the cent.

onboarding.title:
Spending that
explains itself
onboarding.body: One bar, five categories, no guesswork. See the week at a glance instead of scrolling a ledger.

onboarding.title:
Your numbers
never stored
onboarding.body: Card numbers and security codes are never written to disk. Only the last four digits ever leave the keypad.
